claims.originating_goal: Provide a bounded account lifecycle whose Site UI requests InTr authentication assertions, projects the KV directory only after admitted identity proof, appends searchable hash-chained login attempts/outcomes into Account Info, and requires a separate step-up assertion before projecting SKAP; no raw credential disclosure to Site.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release after exact InTr assertion/KV projection/login-audit hash-chain/SKAP step-up validation passes, PR merges, and public publication is observed; otherwise remain fail-closed with this claim.
expected_evidence: Site requests credential verification and receives a bounded assertion rather than credential disclosure
production InTr verifier absence fails closed rather than silently using local test authority
test-only local verifier can exercise the same assertion consumer without persisting plaintext passwords
valid identity assertion admits the KV directory projection
Account Info appends LOGIN_ATTEMPT then LOGIN_SUCCESS for successful login
Account Info appends LOGIN_ATTEMPT then LOGIN_FAILED for invalid login
each login audit event has a canonical searchable SHA-256 login_event_hash
each account uses a deterministic account_ref_sha256 search/correlation handle
login events are linked by prior_login_event_hash and hashes deterministically recompute
raw username/password are absent from login audit records
successful login audit binds non-secret assertion ID/assurance metadata
Personal Info is exposed as a KV directory UI surface
SKAP remains visibly locked after ordinary login
SKAP projection requires a separate step-up assertion
Device/KV and KV/SKAP boundaries remain distinct
real email/SMS delivery is not claimed until a transport is attached
collision_boundaries: test/projection surface; no production identity/session authority until real InTr verifier is provisioned
Site must not receive stored raw credentials or SKAP secret values
login audit must not persist raw username/password/credential material
login event hash/search semantics are evidence correlation only and grant no authority
cloud hosting authority is separate from identity/KV/SKAP authority
no SKAP credential custody in Site
no provider credential or GitHub-token runtime authority
claims.next_task_after_release: Provision and observe a real InTr verifier/route, then replace TEST_ONLY assertion issuance and local login-audit storage with resident InTr/KV custody while retaining the same assertion-consumer, searchable hash-chain, and SKAP step-up boundaries.
